explanation: "DC_n fails for some n over every characteristic-0 field K." This follows from BCW82 (DC_n ⇒ JC_n over a fixed field) and the dimension-3 Jacobian counterexample (Alpöge 2026; elsewhere in this audit set I verified det = 1 and non-injectivity of that map). The map has rational coefficients and non-injectivity at rational points, so JC_3 fails over every characteristic-0 field. Endomorphisms are encoded as K-algebra maps of WeylAlgebra K (Fin n), and "automorphism" as bijective. The statement is correct and solved.
